summary: DriveMate first-iteration testing complete. Backend: 9/9 pytest tests passed (auth, students, feedback, slots CRUD, instructor stats, /me update). Frontend: All requested flows work with cookie-based test session — login page renders Google button + CPUT branding, dashboard requires auth, roster shows 5+ seeded students with progress bars and Code badges, search filters correctly, Feedback modal saves with toast, Add Student modal creates and appears in table, Slot Scheduler shows 5 seeded rows and Add New Slot creates a row, Profile stats grid renders (Rating/Total Hours/Students/Slots) and editable form persists updates.

issues: Sonner success toast (top-right) can overlap the user avatar/name in the header. Consider moving toast to bottom-right or offsetting from header.

For test/admin accounts whose email != lesegoryan36@gmail.com, Total Hours falls back to completed_slots count only (e.g., '1 Hrs'). The 142-hour boost is hardcoded to a single admin email. Consider always using max(completed_slots, seed_value) or driving from data.

action_items: (Optional) Reposition Sonner toaster to avoid overlapping header avatar area.
(Optional) Decouple the 142-hour boost from a hardcoded email so any admin/instructor sees seed hours.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: total_hours boost is hardcoded to ADMIN_EMAIL='lesegoryan36@gmail.com' — brittle if the admin email changes; prefer role-based logic or DB field.
server.py: /api/students PATCH uses StudentCreate model which forces all fields to be overwritten (no partial updates). Consider a StudentUpdate model with Optional fields, mirroring SlotUpdate.
AuthContext.checkAuth only runs on mount; after login success there is no explicit refetch call in AuthCallback path shown here (verify AuthCallback triggers checkAuth after /auth/session).

CORS_ORIGINS='*' combined with allow_credentials=True is technically invalid per CORS spec; browsers may reject credentialed requests. Currently works because backend explicitly reflects, but should be restricted to the frontend origin in production.
test_credentials: MongoDB session: session_token=test_drivemate_token_2026, user_id=test-user-drivemate, email=testinstructor@drivemate.test, role=admin. Use as Authorization: Bearer <token> or cookie session_token on the preview domain.
seed_data_creation: Used existing seeded data (5 students, 5 slots). Tests created a few TEST_-prefixed students/slots/feedback which were not fully cleaned up (create tests do not teardown). Non-blocking; safe to purge later via TEST_ prefix filter.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth is via HttpOnly cookie set by /api/auth/session in prod; for automated tests the pre-created MongoDB session token 'test_drivemate_token_2026' works both as Authorization Bearer for API and as a browser cookie (set with secure=true, sameSite='None', httpOnly=false) for the preview domain. All data-testids in the request are correct and stable. Backend and frontend are fully wired and functional.
